name: Perfect Toon World
effectText: This card's name becomes "Toon World" while in the Field Zone. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Toon" card, or 1 card that mentions a "Toon" card by name, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Perfect Toon World" thrice per turn. If another card's effect activates, at the start of its resolution, you can banish 1 Toon monster you control until immediately after that effect resolves (each unique original monster name can only be banished once per turn, by you, by this effect of "Perfect Toon World").
